messages.text: Good morning. The Diplomat Briefcase arrived in splendid condition. I wish to know if your master artisan recommends applying the organic beeswax balm before my journey to Geneva next Tuesday?

Greetings Mr. Singhania. We are thrilled to hear! For your Geneva trip, our master leathercraftsman recommends a light buff with horsehair brush first. The initial factory coat of beeswax balm will shield against mountain moisture.
I ordered the Rajputana Bridle Belt in 34 inch but require a 36 inch waist fit. Please arrange reverse pickup.
